propositions: Rebar 0.11.0 minor release must be cut from main and published to PyPI with version bumps in pyproject.toml and server.json, CHANGELOG curation, and all release guards passing.
Release commit requires DCO sign-off, Gerrit Change-Id, and rebar-ticket trailer; must achieve LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with no unresolved comments before Submit.
release.yml workflow must be dispatched from main with version=0.11.0 and obtain required pypi environment approval; all jobs must complete successfully.
Published 0.11.0 artifact must pass PyPI/PEP 740 attestation verification, GitHub tag/release creation with attached wheel and sdist, and MCP Registry listing.
Fresh channel install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.11.0 must pass probe_rebar.py post-publication validation; any artifact failures require yanking and patch version remediation per rollback policy.
